messages:
maria_cs: quick heads-up - ignite reported 403s immediately after they rotated keys into k8s secret. can someone take a look?

ignite-eng: seeing 403 with body: {"error":"invalid_scope","message":"missing:chat.write"}. no config changes besides the new secret.

sam_se: two quick checks: 1) any stray quotes/newlines in the secret value? 2) was the key created with chat + embeddings scopes for the env?

ignite-eng: created via UI and pasted into secret. i copied from the downloaded file. looks normal when i eyeball it.

leo_devx: can you post a minimal repro curl (redact key) and also show how you injected into k8s? often copy/paste gets a trailing newline.

ignite-eng: curl: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"rwd-3b","input":"ping"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/generate``` response: same 403. for k8s we used `kubectl create secret generic ignite-api --from-file=key=key.txt` where key.txt was the downloaded file.

sam_se: aha. when you use --from-file it includes the exact bytes; many browsers/downloads append a trailing newline. API will accept token but scope parsing can fail if there's whitespace. can you inspect the secret bytes?

leo_devx: asked them to run: `kubectl get secret ignite-api -o go-template='{{index .data "key"}}' | base64 -d | od -An -t c` they returned: `r K k ... \n` (trailing newline visible).

maria_cs: ok so actionable: strip trailing newline when creating secret or use --from-literal. recommend `kubectl create secret generic ignite-api --from-literal=REDWOOD_API_KEY="$KEY"` or `base64 -d key.txt | tr -d '
' | kubectl create secret generic ignite-api --from-file=key=/dev/stdin`.

ignite-eng: removed newline and restarted pods. calls now 200. thanks for the quick triage :tada:

onboard-bot: ticket CS-2189 created: devx task to trim API key on SDK init and add docs note about copy/paste newline gotchas.

leo_devx: we'll include a tiny SDK change: `const key = (process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY || '').trim()` and update quickstart snippet. low-risk patch, rolling to npm.

sam_se: also observed a short burst of 429s during the restart because their deployment rolled many pods in parallel. let's add a note to onboarding checklist: prefer gradual restarts or set client-side concurrency limits (example config: `maxConcurrentRequests: 8`).

maria_cs: added onboarding checklist item and a short troubleshooting blurb in the customer runbook. closing this thread unless ignite reports further issues.
